title: Vaṅgīsa
text: 1. Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2. Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Vaṅgīso aciraarahattappatto hutvā vimutti-sukha-{paṭisaṃvedī} tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi || || Kāveyyamattā vicarimha pubbe || gāmāgamam purāpuraṃ || || ath-addasāma sambuddhaṃ ||saddhā no udapajjatha || || So me dhammam adesesi || khandhe āyatānāni || dhātuyo ca || tassāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna || pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ || || Bahunnam vata atthāya || bodhim ajjhagamā muni || bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañ ca || ye niyāmagataddasā || || Svāgataṃ vata me asi || mama buddhassa santike || tisso vijjā anuppattā || kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan ti || || Pubbe-nivāsaṃ jānāmi || dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ || tevijjo iddhippattomhi || cetopariyāya-kovido ti || || Vaṅgīsa-thera-saṃyuttaṃ || || Tass-uddānaṃ || || Nikkhantam Arati c-eva || Pesalā-atimaññanā || Ānandena Subhāsitā || Sāriputta Pavāraṇā || Parosahassaṃ Kondañño || Moggalānena Gaggarā || Vaṅgīsena dvādasāti || || [page 197] 197 ******************************************** BOOK IX. -- VANA-SAṂYUTTAṂ.
